info.title: Relay Everything API
info.description: Read one person's Relay Everything notes, health, sleep, workouts, places, calendar, saved chats and memory, and add notes. A computer's key also adds facts, changes the memory's columns and the topics of facts and notes, and opens the knowledge web. It deletes nothing. Each caller reaches only the space of the person who connected it or made its key.

get.summary: Search notes, or read a time range
get.description: With `q`, the notes whose text holds every word, as the `search` tool; with `tag`, the notes on that topic and its parts: `source` picks older recorded or typed notes, and `limit` is at most 50. Without `q` or `tag`, every note from `from` to `to`, as the `timeline` tool: both are needed, and `limit` is at most 100. Newest first; read on with `cursor`.

parameters.description: The words to find.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: A topic, such as battery or bike/charging: it finds its parts too, so bike finds bike/charging.

parameters.name: to

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only older recorded notes, or only typed ones.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many notes, at most 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last answer's `nextCursor`, to read the next page.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/London, for days and the times in the answer; America/Toronto when left out.

post.description: Add a typed note, with this key's or app's name as its device, and send it on to the person's webhooks. Send the same `clientId` again after a lost answer: the note is stored once, and `added` is false. 201 when added.

lon.description: Where it was written: longitude. Send it with lat.

place.description: The place's name, such as a street.
